_doc: Wandering packs (owner 2026-10-16: 'groups or parties of mobs, either the same mobs or an assortment, sometimes led by an elite … they would not stick to one place but would wander around … at least 5 … up to 10'). js/sim/packs.js runs them on the routes tools/content-packs.mjs writes (data/provinces/pack-routes.json; Vharlen: vharlen-pack-routes.json). `rules` are shared by every province (a province's own file lays its blocks over these key by key — Vharlen names only its compositions). A COMPOSITION: `members` [{type, count:[lo,hi]}] (bodies before the leader; 5-10 in all with the leader, `size` overrides), `leader` {type, rank, affixes, chance, names, epithets, title} (an elite: a champion with the Pack-leader mark and a name — its death `onLeaderFall`: 'rout' = some members break and run for 6 s, 'enrage' = every member hits 30% harder and 15% faster), `formation` wedge | column | loose, `doing` at a rest: hunt (runs down a `prey`) | graze | camp (lights a fire, `sit`s round it) | rite (a ring round the leader) | march (never rests), `pace` (share of its own speed while walking), `likes` (route kinds it prefers: road, shore, valley, open, cross), `says` {pull, near} (lines a humanoid crew calls out). A composition is only placed in a zone whose camps already hold every kind it brings (tools/content-packs.mjs) — a pack is the zone's own monsters, travelling together. Names are original: no third-party IP, no 'ember'/'veil'/'muster'/'horde'.

member._doc: a pack member against a lone monster of its kind: health, damage, and what it pays (experience, gold, and its own drop chance). Seven members are ~3.2 lone monsters of health and ~2.1 of damage while all of them stand — a real fight that eases as they drop, each one two or three hits (an area skill's work). Measured in tests/C/packs-balance.test.mjs.

leader._doc: the leader against a champion of its kind (its rank and modifiers on top: a Pack-leader champion is still the toughest thing in the pack and pays a champion's sure magic item)

rules._crowd: round 11's crowd rule (World #5) per pack: n players fighting it -> every member's health x (1 + 0.5 (n - 1)); it grows as they join, never shrinks

spoils._doc: a wiped pack leaves its spoils where it fell, only for those who fought it: a chest of this tier (one item of at least this rarity + chest gold), and a share of a level of experience (js/sim/events.js eventReward's rule: a share of the span to the next level)

events._doc: The six wild events (js/sim/wild-events.js: what each does is in its header). Every number here is a knob; anything left out takes the module's default (WILD_DEFAULTS). Each event is an ordinary zone event run: the tracker card, the map pin, the start / end lines, credit by contribution and a personal reward (js/sim/events.js eventReward: `reward.xp` = a share of a level at the event's level, gold grows with the level, and everyone who took part gets a rare item or better). A wave grows with the players there (round 11's crowd rule: head-count x (1 + 0.5 (n - 1)), health x (1 + 0.15 (n - 1))).

eventText._doc: What each wild event says (plain words; {tokens} are filled in). Shared by every province; none of it names a place.

ambush.name: Ambush on the Road
ambush.what: Lying in wait by the road: the {crew}. They spring out on both sides.
ambush.objective: Fight your way out: beat both waves
ambush.start: Ambush! The {crew} spring out of the brush on both sides of the road!
ambush.onSuccess: The last of them flees into the brush. The road is yours again.
ambush.onFail: They have the road. Come back with friends.

caravan.name: Caravan Under Attack
caravan.what: A merchant wagon on the road ahead is under attack by the {crew}. Its drover, {drover}, cannot hold them off alone.
caravan.objective: Drive off the attackers — keep {drover} alive
caravan.start: A merchant wagon ahead is under attack! Its drover, {drover}, is calling for help.
caravan.saved: You saved my wagon — and my neck! Take what you can carry.
caravan.onSuccess: The wagon rolls on, its drover alive thanks to you.
caravan.onFail: The wagon is lost and its drover with it.

nightraid.name: Night Raid on {village}
nightraid.what: Under cover of dark, raiders are closing on {village} from three sides. Its militia have turned out.
nightraid.start: Raiders are closing on {village} in the dark! Its militia are calling for help.
nightraid.onSuccess: The raiders are beaten off. The village will sleep tonight.
nightraid.onFail: The raiders have had their way with the village.

rift.name: A Rift Tears Open
rift.what: A tear in the air is spilling things from somewhere else. Each time a wave is beaten the rift falters — touch it then to set a seal.
rift.objective: Close the rift: set three seals
rift.start: A rift has torn open nearby, in {zone}! Things are coming through it.
rift.falter: The rift falters! Touch it now to set a seal!
rift.missed: The rift flares again — more are coming through!
rift.closed: The last seal holds and the rift folds shut.
rift.onSuccess: The rift is closed. The air smells of thunder.
rift.onFail: The rift tears itself wider and drags itself shut — whatever came through is loose.

warmarch.name: {name} Marches
warmarch.title: Warlord — wanted across the zone
warmarch.what: {name} leads a war-band across {zone}, burning what it passes. It will not stay long — bring friends.
warmarch.start: A warlord marches! {name} leads a war-band across {zone}. Bring friends.
warmarch.gone: The war-band marches on out of reach.
warmarch.onSuccess: The warlord is down and the war-band breaks.

bounty.name: Wanted: {name}
bounty.title: Wanted — a bounty on its head
bounty.what: The people of {zone} have put a price on {name}, who leads the {pack}. It was last seen in the circle on your map — it does not stay put.
bounty.start: A bounty is posted: {name}, leader of the {pack}, is wanted in {zone}. Its last-seen spot is marked on your map.
bounty.onFail: The bounty ran out before anyone claimed it.

eventMonsters._doc: Bodies the wild events bring that are not a zone's own packs: what comes out of a rift (by the zone's level: the first tier whose `upTo` holds it; `guardian` comes with the last wave) and the warlords that march (by level). Torbor Downs' own; Vharlen has its own list in vharlen-packs.json.

pull: Fresh coin on the road! Take them!
Cut them off — don't let them run!
There's only one of them, lads!
near: Keep your voice down, the patrols are out.
Another night on the cold ground. Bah.

pull: Bring them down for the rite!
near: Walk on, stranger. This road is ours tonight.

leader.title: Leads the raiders and their dogs

pull: Over here, lads — a fat one!
Nobody walks the high road free!
